text:
Elena (Email): Quick sync — preparing the 'Pulse' launch newsletter tied to benchmark blog next Thu. Three asks: localization of subject+preheader, AMP card sanity check for demo snippet, and a conservative ramp plan.
Kai (Growth): Prefer localize subject into EN/FR/DE + fallback EN. Also test preheader length: 50 vs 90 chars on a 5k split.
Priya (Marketing Ops): Adding segment cuts: 
```
segment,filter,estimate
engaged_30d,opened_or_clicked_30d,38k
trialers_recent,trial_started_0-14d,12k
inactive_long,signup_>90d_no_engage,9k
partners_list,partner_flag=true,4k
```
Priya (Marketing Ops): We'll exclude unsubscribed, hard_bounced_365d, and sfdc_closed_lost.
Liam (Deliverability): On AMP — we need to verify the AMP validation (tooling gives preview) and also confirm our ESP supports AMP-signed MIME parts. If AMP fails, fallback to interactive GIF + plain link.
Ava (Product): I can provide a trimmed interactive demo bundle (300KB) and a static screenshot. Which is preferred in AMP card?
Elena (Email): AMP if it validates. Static image fallback otherwise. Keep demo as primary CTA.
Kai (Growth): For subject test: "New benchmark: faster inference for real apps" vs personalized: "New benchmark: {{company}}'s devs will like this". Run on engaged_30d 25/75. If uplift >10% lift in CTR, expand.
Priya (Marketing Ops): Seed plan: 400 seeds (150 Gmail, 100 Outlook, 50 Yahoo, 100 enterprise). Seed send 24h prior. Also request deliverability dashboard link.
deploy-bot: preview generated: https://app.redwood.internal/sends/preview/2965432100 (expires in 48h)
Liam (Deliverability): Ramp suggestion: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> rest over 3 hours. Monitor ISP bounces and complaint rate in first 30m. If complaint rate >0.25% hit, pause.
Elena (Email): Also set List-Unsubscribe header and add Return-Path to dedicated subdomain. Priya can we enable header injection?
Priya (Marketing Ops): Yep, enabling headers and tagging sends with campaign_id=bench_pulse_v1. We'll also add `X-Feedback-Name` per Outlook req.
Kai (Growth): Localization note — translate subject+preheader only. Email body stays EN for now to save QA cycles. We'll add FR/DE body if top-line uplift merits it.
Ava (Product): Asset pushed: /Marketing/Pulse/demo_bundle_v1.zip and screenshot pulse_hero.png
Elena (Email): Final approvals: @Kai for subject, @Ava for assets, @Liam for deliverability sign-off. Can we lock copy by Tue 10:00 PT?
Kai (Growth): I'm on it. Will post subject variants here by Monday EOD.
Liam (Deliverability): I'll run AMP validation and seed checks Tue 11:00 PT and report back.
Elena (Email): Thanks — I'll draft the send matrix and share preview link in this thread when ready. :shipit:
